deterministic_ci_gate: dataset, query-set, similarity and contract digests must match the baseline
exact source-derived field invariants cannot regress
recorded retrieval holdout floors cannot regress
all grounding, tool-boundary and security cases must pass
unsupported claims after the deterministic gate must equal zero
informational_model_dependent: live Ollama tool selection, natural-language output, token counts and latency
local model fallback rate and done reason
informational_performance: exact-cosine scan timings and memory estimates

baselinePolicy: Normal runs never overwrite the baseline. --update-baseline requires an explicit release note and records all input digests.
costPolicy: Local API monetary cost is not applicable/not measured; token and duration usage are reported when actually returned.
